thread:
maya: Quick heads-up — scheduling a rollout tonight (2026-03-17) at 22:00 UTC for runtime v3.5. No DB schema changes. Plan: 1) 1% canary for 5m, 2) 10% for 5m, 3) ramp to 100% if green. Need smoke owners, rollback lead, and infra watcher. Please ack ASAP.

joel: I can be rollback lead. Will keep the rollback command ready and be online ~21:50 UTC. What’s the canary control mechanism?

sophia: I’ll own smoke tests (latency, 5xx, mem/regressions). Checklist I’ll run:
- verify canary route is healthy
- run warmup traffic script
- run quick eval on top-prod prompts
- check token-per-second metrics and error budget

Smoke quick command (local):
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}' | jq '.choices[0].text'
```
I’ll post pass/fail in this thread.

dennis: I’ll handle the canary weight flip and infra pre-warm. Canary weight is controlled via the mesh flag `canary.weight` in svc-config. I’ll set to 1 then 10 per plan and pre-warm caches at ~21:40 UTC. I’ll also tail pod mem/cpu.

ops-oncall: Oncall will watch SLO dashboards and incidents channel. I’ll enable the rollout runbook and set an alert for sustained >1% errors over 2m. Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.runbooks/rollout-runtime. I’ll also set a 10m watch window after full ramp.

deploy-bot: CI: runtime-v3.5-build #482 passed ✅ (unit+smoke). Pipeline: https://ci.redwood/jobs/482 — image sha: sha256:abc123

maya: Thanks everyone. Joel, rollback command below (tested in staging):
```bash
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/runtime --to-revision=42
# verify pods come back: kubectl get pods -l app=runtime -w
```
Please keep that handy.

joel: Got it — will execute if we see sustained failures. I’ll also coordinate a quick db-flag toggle if needed: `feature-flag disable runtime-newkernel`.

sophia: Small note: eval harness found one prompt regression ~2% for long-context cases on headless tests — not blocking but will monitor. If we see a >5% regression during canary, we abort.

dennis: Pre-warm script: `python infra/tools/prewarm.py --pool runtime-v3.5 --concurrency 20` — I’ll run at 21:40.

maya: Final checklist (please react with :thumbsup: when you’ve completed your prep):
- [ ] rollback lead assigned (joel)
- [ ] smoke owner assigned (sophia)
- [ ] infra pre-warm scheduled (dennis)
- [ ] oncall monitoring enabled (ops-oncall)
- [ ] CI green (deploy-bot)

Reply here with times you’ll be available.

joel: :thumbsup: available 21:50-23:30 UTC.

sophia: :thumbsup: will post smoke results immediately after canary (~22:06 UTC).

dennis: :thumbsup: pre-warm @21:40, will flip weights at 22:00 and 22:05.

ops-oncall: :thumbsup: will be watching from 21:45-23:00 UTC and will escalate on alert thresholds.

maya: Great — thanks. I’ll kick the deploy at 22:00 UTC if all thumbs up by 21:55. If anyone sees anything odd before then ping me directly.

sophia: will also leave short checklist output in #incidents-smoke after checks.

joel: one more — if we need a quick rollback, prefer to call a 5m freeze and then run the command. Will coordinate in thread.

maya: Copy. Standby for final go/no-go at 21:55 UTC. :rocket:
